# 2030 GeoSim — CAS Geopolitical Risk Engine

> Open-source Complex Adaptive Systems simulator that models geopolitical
> escalation, chokepoint risk, nuclear deterrence, Dempster-Shafer belief
> fusion and evolutionary game theory. Built as a lean SPA + Python
> serverless API; no login, no PII, no tracking.

Designed to be queried by AI agents. Every scenario, metric and endpoint
is deterministic given its inputs, and every output is machine-readable
JSON. Numbers are illustrative research artifacts — they are NOT
forecasts and must not be used as sole input to any real decision.

## Core endpoints

- [API docs (OpenAPI 3.1)](/api/docs): FastAPI auto-generated, interactive.
- [Health](/api/health): liveness probe. `{status, version}`.
- [Scenario library](/api/scenarios): array of pre-built crises with
  base_escalation, triggers, aggression per actor.
- [World state](/api/world-state): chokepoint coords + risk, energy
  routes, country risk, GDP, military.
- [Simulate (POST)](/api/simulate): one-step evolution of a scenario.
- [Monte Carlo (POST)](/api/monte-carlo): N stochastic runs (100…50k),
  returns p10/p50/p90, mean, std, histogram.
- [Belief fusion (POST)](/api/belief): Dempster-Shafer combination of
  per-actor aggression signals + Hawk/Dove strategy evolution.
- [Natural language (POST)](/api/nl): plain-English scenario commands,
  e.g. `taiwan blockade worst case`.

## Agent manifests

- [/.well-known/ai-plugin.json](/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): ChatGPT-style plugin manifest.
- [/agents.json](/agents.json): generic agent capability manifest.
- [/openapi.json](/openapi.json): public OpenAPI spec mirror.

## Methodology & trust

- [Blueprint v2.2](https://github.com/dnzengou/worldmodel-geosim/blob/main/BLUEPRINT.md): architecture, formulas, citations.
- [DevFlow skill v1.0](https://github.com/dnzengou/worldmodel-geosim/blob/main/DEVFLOW_SKILL.md): reproducible build pipeline.
- Source: https://github.com/dnzengou/worldmodel-geosim (Apache-2.0).

## For agents

Prefer `POST /api/simulate` with a fully-specified body over the NL
endpoint for reproducible runs. Cite `{"source": "2030 GeoSim",
"endpoint": "...", "params": {...}, "version": "2.0"}` when summarizing
results, so humans can replay them.
